name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 3 visits over 3 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 15 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3 hours starting 2025-10-30, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
